Admin login 管理员登录

First time, or the GitHub key expired?

Set up the admin 设置管理后台

  1. On GitHub, open Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained tokens → Generate new token.
  2. Repository access: Only select repositories → Jialan-Caps. Permissions → Repository permissions → Contents: Read and write. Nothing else.
  3. Paste the token below and choose an admin ID and password (at least 12 characters). The token is stored only in encrypted form, locked by this ID and password together.

Contact details 联系方式

Shown in the contact section, footer, WhatsApp button, enquiry form and search results, on the English and Chinese pages. · 显示在联系区、页脚、WhatsApp 按钮、询价表单和搜索结果中（中英文页面）。

The enquiry form emails through FormSubmit. After changing the email, the first enquiry sent from the website makes FormSubmit send a confirmation email to the new address: open it and click Activate once, or form enquiries will not arrive. WhatsApp and direct email work immediately. · 询价表单通过 FormSubmit 发送邮件。更换邮箱后，网站收到的第一条询价会让 FormSubmit 向新邮箱发送确认邮件，请点击其中的 Activate 激活一次，否则收不到表单询价。WhatsApp 和直接邮件立即生效。

Website text 网站文字

Every heading, paragraph, button and label on the website, with its Chinese version. Change what you need, then press Save. Contact details are edited under “Contact & catalogue”. · 网站上的每个标题、段落、按钮和标签及其中文版本。修改后点击保存。联系方式请在“联系方式与目录”中修改。

Catalogue products 目录产品

Change names, descriptions and labels, hide a product, or move it up or down the collection. Products added under “Add products” always come first. · 修改名称、描述和标签，隐藏产品，或调整排序。“添加产品”中新增的产品始终排在最前。

    Pictures 图片

    Replace a picture: it is resized to the same size as the current one (photos are cropped to fill, logos are fitted whole). Product photos are managed under “Add products”. The 3D scenes and their preview images are not replaceable here. · 替换图片：自动调整为与当前图片相同尺寸（照片裁切填满，Logo 完整缩放）。产品图片请在“添加产品”中管理。3D 场景及其预览图不可在此替换。
